eq:trajectory_hellinger_recursion.scope: Hellinger distance of normalized prefix and complete trajectory laws equals the square root of one minus the total recursively propagated geometric-mean overlap. Layer state types may vary; zero probabilities are allowed. Lean counts elapsed steps n=L-l; n=L gives the full trajectory law.

eq:multiplicative_dc_recovery.scope: Exact polarized recursive decomposition of finite scalar expressions: nonnegative convex monotone heads on independent nonnegative doubled inputs, and globally convex nonnegative heads after the canonical signed-input split. Applies to multiplicative ReLU computations; matrices and convolutions reduce to scalar sums/products and finite maxima to ReLU. No size bound or floating-point guarantee is asserted.
